title: Diving into the Pool
description: A large overweight man wearing purple swim briefs and a black swim cap is captured mid-air in a belly flop dive above a glowing swimming pool at dusk. The pool water shows concentric ripples and a clear underwater reflection of the man, with a diving board, pool noodles, and a single swim fin visible.
prompt: A large overweight man with a black swim cap and purple swim briefs is frozen mid-air performing a belly flop dive directly above a glowing turquoise swimming pool at dusk. The pool water has vibrant concentric ripples spreading from the impact point and shows a clear underwater reflection of the falling man. A weathered diving board with text is visible above, purple pool noodles and a swim fin float in the water. Palm trees, city buildings and a colorful sunset sky fill the background in a highly detailed realistic digital painting style.
